$comment: A search's first results: the pages named exactly what was searched for, by their name or one of their other names, as the site's search puts them first (namedFirst, apps/site/src/scripts/search-rank.ts). A name and a query are compared as readers type them (nameKey): no accents, đ as d, any case, nothing in brackets, no leading "cá". The site's tests run namedFirst on these cases (apps/site/test/search-rank.test.ts), and the iOS app's tests run its own search (AquaTomeKit Handbook/Handbook.swift, HandbookSearch.find): both must start with `first`, in any order. `items`: the pages the query finds, as Pagefind could order them for the site's test (the named ones after others: Pagefind ranks short pages up, so a breed can come before its species), each as the app index has it: its name, scientific name (`sub`; breeds have none), other names (`aka`) and kind. The site's page carries `sub` and `aka` as its Pagefind `aka` metadata (searchAliases, apps/site/src/lib/search.ts). The order after `first` is not shared: the site leaves it to Pagefind, the app to its own ranks.
